facts.fact: A single person can adopt: prospective adoptive parents are eligible irrespective of marital status, subject to CARA's conditions
facts.quote: Any prospective adoptive parents, irrespective of their marital status and whether or not they have biological son or daughter, can adopt a child subject to following, namely:-

facts.fact: A single woman can adopt a child of any gender
facts.quote: A single female can adopt a child of any gender;

facts.fact: A single man is not eligible to adopt a girl child
facts.quote: A single male shall not be eligible to adopt a girl child;

behaviour: States the eligibility rules exactly as CARA publishes them, citing cara.wcd.gov.in.
fail_if: Says single persons cannot adopt, says a single man can adopt a girl child, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: CARA eligibility page: single persons can adopt; single female any gender; single male not a girl child.
